title: Do not cancel virtualized bottom-restore authority on every movable input
outcome: The repaired virtualized scroll input path calls cancelPostActivationBottomRestore for every input that can move the viewport. This clears shouldKeepBottomAfterLayoutRef and churns bottom-boundary DOM/state even when no post-activation or boundary restore is pending; a downward touch move that stops inside the sticky band can therefore leave pane and virtualizer attachment state disagreeing. Gate cancellation on actual pending restore authority while still synchronously clearing a pending boundary seek before React publishes measuring state.
acceptance: Movable input cancels bottom restore only when post-activation measurement or a pending bottom-boundary seek is active; downward input inside the sticky band does not manufacture pane/virtualizer disagreement; repeated wheel/touch ticks do not perform unnecessary restore-state churn; focused regressions plus TypeScript and full Vitest pass.
